title: mri_vol2label
description: Converts values in a volume or surface overlay to a label using specified parameters.

label_id.description: Value to match in the input.
label_id.title: Label ID

threshold.description: Threshold the input to make label (i.e., input > threshold) instead of using Label ID.
threshold.title: Threshold

vol_file.description: Write label volume in this file.
vol_file.title: Volume file

surf_subject_hemi.description: Interpret input as surface overlay with the given subject and hemisphere (optionally with surface).
surf_subject_hemi.title: Surface subject and hemisphere

surf_path.description: Specify surface path instead of subject/hemi.
surf_path.title: Surface path

opt_params.description: Treats input as a probability map. Format: target delta valmap.
opt_params.title: Optimization parameters

remove_holes.description: Remove holes in label and islands (with --surf only).
remove_holes.title: Remove holes and islands flag
